LESSON: THE GOOD LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The early life 3.2 Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to 
Topic 3.3: The good life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The good life of Jesus Christ. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What did he do?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the acts of the good Samaritan by being kind to people in need

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the acts of the good Samaritan by being kind to people in need
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the acts of the good Samaritan by being kind to people in need. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The good life of Jesus Christ.
2. Explain The good life of Jesus Christ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The good life of Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the acts of the good Samaritan by being kind to people in need
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The good life of Jesus Christ. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What did he do?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the acts of the good Samaritan by being kind to people in need

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
